Disclaimer
Thank you for choosing to use ValorVDC Revit families, but please be advised these families were created from manufacturer submittals and/or dimensional catalogs from the public domain, and we try to get our measurements to within a 1/32" of the manufacture's dimensions. We try to get our families as close to the real thing as possible, but dimensional mistakes can happen, and production molds do change. So by using ValorVDC families, you understand it is your responsibility to double-check these components before you prefabricate any assemblies or do any coordination.
